Short biography

Nolan Kido builds and examines practical AI workflows for everyday life and small-business work. His guiding principle is AI Works Human Decides: AI assists with defined tasks while people verify results and retain responsibility.

Save short biography (.txt)

A little more context

Nolan Kido builds and examines practical ways to use AI in everyday life and small-business work. His guiding principle, AI Works Human Decides, keeps purpose, verification, permissions, and consequential choices with people. On his website he shares inspectable tools, recorded examples, and what they can and cannot establish. His other interests include Living Well, tournament poker, writing, and creative work.

Useful context

Three examples behind the biography.

AI Task Brief Builder
Use: a browser-based template that turns your own inputs into a task brief with checks and boundaries. It makes no AI call and does not measure productivity.
Checking an AI-assisted website change
Inspect: a documented website-release defect, its correction and the checks involved. It is one recorded case, not a general performance claim.
Let AI do more. Keep the judgment.
Understand: an essay about delegating production while keeping purpose, boundaries and responsibility with people. It expresses a viewpoint, not a benchmark.

These links show different kinds of public work, not evidence of credentials, endorsements, or independently measured impact. The biographies above remain concise enough to reuse without attaching unsupported claims.
